The Pasco Taco Crawl Committee is again bringing a taco-themed charity event to Pasco. On Saturday, October 13 there will be a one day only event called a "Taco Sprint." Taco Crawlers will buy $5 punch cards online or on location in downtown Pasco. The card will 
get crawlers one delicious taco from each of the four participating vendors. A beer and margarita garden will be hosted by Out and About, with one dollar from each beverage there going to the Boys & Girls Clubs of Benton and Franklin Counties.

Out and About Presents:

I see you shiver with Antici…………...Pation!

Rocky Horror is coming to Club Out and About for a two-night only Drag Show Shadow Cast Extravaganza! 
Expect to be thrilled, chilled, and fulfilled as our Queens and Kings take the stage portraying your favorite characters from Richard O’Brain’s cult classic, The Rocky Horror Picture Show. 
Audience participation is not encouraged, it is MANDATORY! Rocky Horror culture will be hitting the scene full force in this Dragged-Out interpretation, if you dreamed of a Rocky Horror even gayer than the original film, then you are in for a treat!

Tickets are $15 at the door, seating is limited! Tickets can be purchased at the door. The first twenty guests to arrive will receive a free prop bag to fully participate in the fun. Pre Show events and costume contest will start at 9pm, there will be a prize for best Rocky Horror costume and a prize for best general costume.

This is a 21 and older event. Valid ID is required.

**Any pre-sale tickets purchased online will be at Will Call, Tickets are still available at the door***

Leather Azimuth is hosting an official public Pet Mosh located in Pasco, WA at Out and About nightclub.

The mosh will start at 7:00 pm and will include a rough moshing area, a calmer relaxation area, and a small ball pit.
All genders, identities, orientations, and species welcome! Come out and mosh with pups and pets or just learn about human pet play in a comfortable, no judgment environment.

21 and Over
Valid ID required
Free cover before 9PM

SPECIAL GUEST MICRO is a positive, active participant and proponent of pup and pup play and has been for many years. Micro currently holds the title of Washington State Mr. Leather 2018. In 2017 he was bestowed the great honor of being the International Puppy Contest's Best in Show award recipient at the first ever joint International Puppy Contest (IPC)/International Pup and Trainer Contest (IPTC) event. As well as these honors, Micro is currently an elected member-at-large on the executive board of Seattle Pups and Handlers (SEA-PAH) in his hometown of Seattle, Washington. As well as his involvement in SEA-PAH, Micro is also a member of Portland Pets and Handlers (PDX-PAH) and Seattle Men in Leather (SML) and regularly attends and supports their events.

Puppy 101 Class Topics (~40mins of content):

* Pet Play/Pup Play/What is pup play
* What’s the Criteria of Being a Puppy or Handler?
* History of modern human pup play.
* Headspace.
* Safety/gear to protect yourself.
* Hierarchy and packs.
* Respect when engaging pups in the wild.

If you have any questions you can call the club directly at (509) 543 3796, ask for Jay.

CROWN ROYAL HISTORY

In 1939, King George VI and Queen Elizabeth made history when they became the first reigning monarchs to visit Canada, arriving by boat and traveling the vast North American distance by train.

Upon hearing the historic news, a Canadian spirits entrepreneur set out to craft a whisky suited for the Royal Couple – an exceptionally generous gift fit for royalty. With perfection on his mind, he meticulously trialed more than 600 blends before outfitting the final product in a cut-glass decanter and regal purple bag with gold stitching. The whisky he presented to the King and Queen was an exquisitely smooth blend of roughly fifty whiskies which became known, fittingly, as Crown Royal.

The train carrying the monarchs was stocked with 10 cases of the royal blend and rumors of the unrivaled whisky fit for a King quickly spread. Crown Royal was released in the United States in the 1960s and has since become the top selling Canadian whisky.

To this day, every drop of Crown Royal is crafted to meet the same uncompromising standards, making it, to many discerning palates, the finest whisky of all.

Please drink responsibly.

201644454280_1043812904413507.message:
We're excited to announce that we have officially purchased Out and About, a cherished LGBTQ+ bar that has stood as a beacon of community and belonging in the Tri-Cities for the past 25 years. This space carries a rich history, built by those who came before us, who fought for the right to gather, celebrate, and thrive openly. We honor their legacy and their struggles that helped create this sanctuary, and it is with deep gratitude that we now carry the torch to keep it alive.

As a Latino gay couple, my husband and I are committed to preserving Out and About as a welcoming, safe space for the LGBTQ+ community here in Eastern Washington. While we make a few updates to refresh the bar, we ask for your patience and trust in us to uphold its legacy. Together, we will ensure that this space remains a diverse and vibrant hub where everyone can feel seen, heard, and embraced for years to come. Stay tuned for updates as we look forward to a grand reopening and the continued strength of our community.

If you have any memories and or pictures of the history of Out and About, please share them below ❤️

A New Chapter Begins: Introducing Azúcar at Out And About!

After 29 incredible years as "Out And About," we're embracing the future with a fresh look, new energy, and a bold new name: Azúcar at Out and About!

This isn't about leaving the past behind—it's about celebrating our history, our community, and refreshing our beloved space to keep the spirit alive for generations to come. Azúcar isn't just sugar—it's an homage to Afro-Latina legend Celia Cruz, whose joyous cry "¡Azúcar!" inspired people across the Americas to dance, celebrate, and live boldly.

What's New?

Multiple dance floors with diverse beats—from iconic pop hits on our industrial dance floor to lively norteñas, rancheras, and Latin rhythms in our dedicated Latino room.

Spaces designed to build community, connection, and unforgettable memories—some rooms with NO COVER, so everyone can join the dance!

A tribute to the legacy and diversity of our Eastern Washington community, honoring those who built and sustained "Out And About," while warmly welcoming everyone into our evolving space.

We can't wait to celebrate this exciting new chapter with you! Join us for a series of unforgettable grand openings featuring beloved drag queens, community celebrations, and endless dancing.

Here's to the next 29 years of music, community, and joy.

Come dance with us —¡Azúcar!

We’re honored and grateful 

Reading this story in the Tri-City Herald reminded us why Azúcar exists — because our community deserves a space to dance, connect, and be unapologetically ourselves.

For nearly 30 years, Out and About has been more than a bar — it’s been home for so many. Today, Azúcar at Out and About continues that legacy with a fresh Latin heartbeat and the same spirit of love and belonging. ❤️

We’re so happy to be here with y’all. The best way to help this community grow is simple: come out, show up, and celebrate with us! 

If there’s an event you’d love to see — or even help create — come talk to us. Our team and partners are passionate about making this space for you and with you.

Check out our upcoming events on Facebook and Instagram, and let’s keep this energy alive together.

Congratulations to Calixto Hernandez for Pasco City Council District.

Pasco’s District 2 just welcomed a new voice to the City Council, and we couldn’t be more proud. Calixto has lived in our neighborhood for many years, understands the day-to-day realities of our community, and brings a lived perspective that truly reflects who we are. As an openly LGBTQ+ member of our community, his presence in local leadership is both meaningful and inspiring.

We also want to extend a warm thank-you to the previous council representative for their service to our district.

This moment matters—not just for representation, but for the future we’re building together. Seeing someone from our own comunidad step into this role gives hope, visibility, and a sense of belonging for many.

Felicidades, Calixto — y gracias.

Meet & Greet with Pasco’s New City Council Member, Calixto Hernández! 

📅 December 16th • 🕖 7:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out and About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco, WA

Pasco, this is a special moment for our community.
Calixto Hernández — born, raised, and shaped by our city — has officially been sworn in as our newest representative for District 6, the historic heart of downtown where so many families live, work, and dream.

Calixto knows our neighborhood because he’s been part of it his whole life. Many of us have seen him around for years, showing up, supporting our spaces, and sharing in the same community spirit that makes Pasco so unique. His presence has always meant something here at Azucar at Out and About — and now, it means even more.

This is your chance to meet him, connect, and talk about the bright future of our city and District 6.
We’ll have light drinks, snacks, and a welcoming space for conversation and celebration.

Let’s come together to congratulate Calixto, honor this milestone, and show him the love and community that raised him. 

Nos vemos el 16 de diciembre — te esperamos. 🌈

NOCHE VAQUERA
Sábado 9 de Mayo | Azucar at Out & About
Compadres... esta noche no es para los que se quedan en casa. 😏🔥
La noche más caliente del Pacifico Noroeste está de vuelta, y esta vez viene con más cuero, más pelo, más botas... y mucho más actitud. 💪🏽👢
Si eres VAQUERO, OSO, o de los que les gusta el CUERO — esta noche fue hecha para ti. Trae tu sombrero, ajústate las botas, ponte esa vest que tanto te gusta y ven a demostrar de qué estás hecho. 🐻🤠
¿Que qué hay de especial esta noche?
✨ La inigualable, la incomparable, la única FRIVOLA abre la noche con un show de drag que te va a dejar sin palabras — y posiblemente sin aliento. Perfecta para los vaqueros que saben apreciar el arte... y el escándalo. 💃🏽🎤
🌟 INVITADO ESPECIAL DEL MES — sorpresa que cambia cada mes, porque aquí no nos gusta aburrirnos. Y tú tampoco deberías. 😉
🚪 Puertas abren: 8:30 PM
🎭 Show comienza: 9:30 PM — en punto, mijos, que aquí sí arrancamos.
💚 ENTRADA LIBRE si llegas con:
👢 Botas + sombrero de vaquero
🖤 Vest de cuero O sombrero de cuero
Sí, así como lo lees. Vístete pa' la ocasión y la noche es tuya. 🙌🏽
📞 RESERVA TU MESA — No te quedes parado en la puerta como si no supieras a lo que viniste. Las mesas vuelan, y los que llaman primero, bien sentaditos se quedan. 😈 Llámanos para reservar.
Noche Vaquera es CADA SEGUNDO SÁBADO DEL MES — porque la buena vida no puede esperar más de dos semanas. 🐂🖤
¿Vas a dejar que la noche pase sin ti? 👀
Ven. Huele a cuero. Siente la música. Y deja que la noche te haga lo que el día no pudo. 😏🔥

201644454280_1598070498987742.message:
Twenty years in the making 💃

Valeria Sanchez is the kind of artist you only get to witness if you are paying attention. She trained at the Escuela de Bellas Artes in both Mexican folklórico and flamenco, and she has carried that training onto stages all around the world. Twenty years of dedication to her craft, and she is nowhere near slowing down. On top of performing, she teaches, passing everything she knows on to the next generation of dancers.

At Latino/a Pride she takes the stage as a soloist. When the music starts and that skirt begins to fly, you will understand exactly why people call this an art form. It is power, history, and pure beauty all moving at once, and it is rare to see it this close to home.

Do not look away for a second. You are going to want to remember this one.

201644454280_1598550345606424.message:
Folklórico royalty, right here at home 👢

For the very first time at Azúcar, we get to welcome Ballet Folklórico Cielo de México to our Pride stage. This is a local Tri Cities treasure, a crew of five to ten dancers bringing the traditional dances of northern México to life with the skirts, the boots, and the zapateado that you feel in your chest.

These dancers perform all throughout the year, and their famous annual showcase is honestly one of the most beautiful things you can experience locally. If you have never seen it, put it on your list, because it is the kind of show people talk about for weeks afterward. For now, we are lucky enough to have them at Azúcar, and we could not be more proud to share our stage with them.

They also teach all ages, so if watching them makes you want to learn, they are the ones to find. Come celebrate culture that lives and breathes right here at home.

Come for the queens, stay for the goods 🛍️

The stage is only half the fun. Our Latino/a Pride vendor village is fully stacked, so bring a little cash and an empty tote, because you are absolutely going to want to take something home with you.

The Mad Tatter is our resident tattoo artist, ready to send you home with fresh ink and a story to go with it. Belinda's Bloom brings the flowers and that pop of color every good celebration needs. Mad Art Club shows up as your friendly neighborhood art collective right here in the Tri Cities. Bro and Sister Lemonade is sibling powered and seriously sour, the exact kind of refreshing that hits perfectly on a warm Pride afternoon.

Free Mom Hugs will be there too, offering exactly what the name promises, and if you know, you know just how much that can mean to someone. Siren is on hand for photography, so you walk away with a moment worth framing. Rooted Care Collective is bringing the massage therapists, because even your shoulders deserve a little Pride treatment. And Aub's Banana Bread is rounding it out with bread so good we are choosing to keep most of the jokes to ourselves.

Pull up, support local, and treat yourself a little. You earned it.

Latino/a Pride, presented by Azúcar at Out & About. The largest Latino Pride in Eastern Washington.
Saturday, June 13. Festival outside 4PM to 9PM, all ages. Doors open inside at 9PM, 21 and up.
327 W Lewis St, Pasco.

La elegancia hecha drag. El rojo no es un color, es una declaración — y Victoria lo lleva como armadura. Cuando sube al escenario, no necesita hablar para que sepas quién es: lo dice la mirada, lo dice la entrada, lo dicen las curvas que se mueven con propósito. 👑🌹

🌈✨ THREE MORE DAYS until Latino/a Pride in Pasco and we are in full celebration mode! 

Azucar @ Out & About, 327 W Lewis St, June 13th — doors open at 4pm and the fun does not stop. 

We want to take a moment to say what this event truly means to us. Latino/a Pride was created to give the Latino LGBTQ+ community a place to exist loudly and joyfully, to see their identities reflected in the faces around them, and to celebrate without apology. 

In a world that doesn’t always make space for queer Latino voices, we are making that space — right here in Pasco. And we’re inviting everyone to share in it. 

Allies, families, friends, people from every walk of life — if you come with love and an open heart, you are home. Live performances, live music, 15+ vendors, and a night dance party await. 

All ages until 9pm. Three days. Get your outfit ready. Get your squad together. This is going to be everything. 💃🔥💛

En un mundo que no siempre hace espacio para las voces queer Latinas, estamos creando ese espacio — aquí mismo en Pasco. Y estamos invitando a todos a compartirlo. 

Aliados, familias, amigos, personas de todos los ámbitos de la vida — si vienes con amor y un corazón abierto, estás en casa. 

Presentaciones en vivo, música en vivo, más de 15 vendedores, y una fiesta de baile nocturna te esperan. Todas las edades hasta las 9pm. 

Tres días. Prepara tu outfit. Reúne a tu grupo. Esto lo va a ser todo. 💃🔥💛

If you miss this one, we genuinely cannot help you

Bestie, this is THE one. The flyers are out, the lineup is stacked, and half the city has already cleared their Saturday. Latino/a Pride is back on June 13, and it is the largest Latino Pride in all of Eastern Washington.

Picture it. Folklórico spinning across the stage, sacred danza, drag queens both legendary and brand new, hosts who refuse to let the energy drop for even a second, and a DJ running everything from cumbia to reggaetón until your feet beg for mercy. Wrap all of that in a full festival outside with food, drinks, a beer garden, and over fifteen vendors, all ages until 9PM.

Then at 9 we pull it inside and the grown folks take over. Another full drag show, then two rooms going all night, English hip hop and dance in one and Spanish all night long in the other.

Everyone you know is going to be there. The only real question is whether you end up in the photos or just hearing about it all day Monday. Choose wisely.

Save this, send it to the group chat, and tag the friend who always says yes.

Saturday, June 27th 🌈💃
We’re celebrating Lesbian & Lencha Pride Night Market at Azúcar at Out & About.

A night full of color, community, and pride featuring 15+ local women-owned vendors, live music, DJs spinning all night, and closing out the evening with a drag show and burlesque performance before the dance floor opens up.

This event is created to center and celebrate women, lesbians, lenchas, queer women, sapphics, trans women, nonbinary community, and our invited friends and allies.

Azúcar will have multiple rooms open throughout the night. The Main Lounge will be a women-centered space for women only, with Azúcar staff present to serve drinks and support the room. The other rooms will be open for all folks to enjoy the vendors, music, shows, and dance party.

To help keep the night intentional and comfortable, cis straight men are welcome when attending with a woman as part of the celebration. Thank you for helping us honor the spirit of the night and create a safe, joyful, and affirming Pride space.

Come support our vendors, connect with community, and dance the night away.

🕖 7PM | 18+ until 10PM, 21+ after

Six days from tonight, Azúcar is turning into a crafting wonderland. 🌈🔑

We're calling it Build Your Own Carabiner Night, but really, it's an excuse to get our community in one room, hands busy, hearts open, and music playing while we make something to carry with us long after the night ends.

Here's the thing about a carabiner — it's built to hold things together. A ring for your keys, a clip for your bag, a small piece of hardware that keeps what matters close. We loved that symbolism enough to build an entire night around it, because that's what we're trying to do as a community too: hold each other, hold space, and hold on to the connections we've built all summer long.

On Sunday, July 12th from 7–10 PM, grab a carabiner, pick your charms, and build something that's completely, unapologetically you. Come solo and leave with new friends, or bring your whole crew and make a night of it. Either way, you're not just building an accessory — you're building community.

Tickets are $10 at the door, and every dollar goes toward funding our upcoming Sapphic events. Mark your calendar, because this one's going to fill up fast.

📍 327 W Lewis St, Pasco, WA

201644454280_1626774789450646.message:
Five days out, and we want to tell you why we picked a carabiner as the centerpiece of this whole night. 🏳️‍🌈

It's a small piece of hardware most of us carry without thinking twice. But look closer and it's actually a tiny engineering marvel — a loop that opens just wide enough to let something new in, then locks tight enough to never let it go. That's a pretty perfect metaphor for the kind of spaces we're trying to build at Azúcar: open enough for anyone to step into, strong enough that once you're part of this community, you're held.

This Sunday, July 12th from 7–10 PM, you'll get to pick your own carabiner, build it out with charms — think tiny florals, rainbow hearts, cowgirl boots, star charms, and a few surprises we're not spoiling yet — and walk away with something that's part accessory, part memory, part inside joke with whoever's sitting next to you at the craft table.

And here's the part that matters most: every single dollar raised goes directly toward funding our upcoming Sapphic events. So when you clip that carabiner to your bag, you're not just showing off your bedazzling skills — you're wearing proof that you helped build something bigger.

$10 at the door. Doors open at 7 PM.

📍 327 W Lewis St, Pasco, WA

201644454280_1718593920268732.message:
BIG HAIR, BIG HEARTS & A WHOLE LOT OF LOVE! 

From La Familia Azúcar, THANK YOU! 🌈✨
Our Dolly Parton Drag Show Fundraiser was filled with laughter, fabulous performances, dancing, and most importantly, a community coming together to make a difference.
TOGETHER, WE RAISED $650! 
But this night wouldn't have been possible without the incredible people who stepped up and made it happen!
We want to give an EXTRA SPECIAL THANK YOU to VictoriaDeMizer, whose dedication, leadership, and heart helped bring this beautiful fundraiser to life.
And a huge round of applause for our fabulous performers Cherry Pop, Puddlezz, Zero, and Bea! Thank you for sharing your talent, creativity, time, and energy to make this night unforgettable!
A very special thank-you also goes to José from Cabana Bass for being part of this wonderful effort and helping make it all possible!
You didn't just put on a show. You brought people together for a purpose. And that deserves to be celebrated! 
We're proud to share that the $650 raised will be donated to two wonderful causes:

♥️Dolly Parton's Imagination Library, helping put books into the hands of children right here in Benton and Franklin Counties.
❤️ WAISN Worker Collective, supporting and uplifting members of our community.

Because isn't that exactly what Dolly would have done? Spread kindness, lift others up, and use whatever spotlight you have to make the world a little brighter.
To everyone who showed up, bought a drink, tipped a queen, danced, laughed, or simply came to support 

THANK YOU!

At Azúcar, we're more than just a nightclub. We're a familia. And nights like this remind us that when our community comes together, we can have an amazing time while making a meaningful difference.
A little country, a lot of glitter, and a whole lot of HEART! 

With all our love and gratitude,
LA FAMILIA AZÚCAR

201644454280_833256895469110.message:
It’s with great regret that we have let everyone know this will be the last karaoke show!!! Hopefully we can make tonight memorable and fun! After Covid and many years before I asked the owners and boss man if I could start Karaoke up again, because I have a passion for singing and with creating lasting memories through music and community. Sometimes (in a conservative town) there isn’t a safe place for LGBTQIA people to come together and support each other. I’m very grateful to Out and About for their support in not only my life but for all of us in the Tri-Cities and all over the PNW and beyond. Hopefully we can come back together in the future and sing again. So until then…. All my love and Gratitude! See y’all tonight!!!
